meta.tagline: Mechanical engineer turned AI builder — connecting hardware, software, and ideas that shouldn't exist yet.
meta.positioning_note: Toni sits at the intersection of engineering rigour, AI application, and creative product thinking. Not a pure researcher, not a pure developer — someone who builds things that bridge disciplines and solves real problems with taste.

highlight_modules: Deep Learning for Autonomous Decision Making

projects.title: Leveret AI — Dental X-Ray Diagnosis Platform
projects.short_description: Computer vision platform for automated dental X-ray diagnosis, deployed into NHS beta clinics.
projects.long_description: Collaborated cross-functionally to refine CV training datasets for periapical dental X-ray diagnosis. Led beta testing across NHS dental clinics, achieving ~27% early adoption. Contributed to business use-case development by merging market research with technical feasibility, and bridged communication between engineers and clinical end users.
key_contributions: Training dataset curation and annotation strategy for radiographic pathology
Beta testing coordination with NHS clinics — ~27% early adoption
Bounding box strategy for dental X-ray bounding regions
Competitor dental software analysis and UX gap identification
Business use-case documentation and stakeholder communication
metrics: ~27% early adoption rate in beta NHS clinics
projects.learnings: Applying AI in regulated clinical environments requires as much attention to workflow integration and user trust as to model accuracy.

projects.title: MagKits — iPhone Accessory Brand
projects.short_description: MagSafe wallet brand built around football clubs — custom product design, Shopify store, supply chain, and content.
projects.long_description: Founded MagKits as a consumer hardware brand centred on MagSafe wallets for football fans. Oversaw the full stack: product design in Blender and Photoshop, Shopify store deployment, supply chain negotiations, and social media content strategy. Extended into a broader social/e-commerce consulting practice serving other clients.
key_contributions: Custom product design using Blender, Photoshop, Illustrator
Shopify store deployment and Liquid customisation
Supply chain negotiation and logistics management
Social media strategy growing a client following to 500k+ within 2 years
Deployed Vue-based interactive websites for multiple clients
metrics: 500k+ followers grown for a client within 2 years
projects.learnings: Product, brand, and distribution are inseparable — building all three simultaneously forces better decision-making.

projects.title: Bundesliga AI Hackathon — Player Pose Classification
projects.short_description: Automated classification system sorting thousands of media day football photos into 16 pose-based categories.
projects.long_description: Developed an automated pipeline to classify football player images into 16 predefined pose categories for the Bundesliga media day archive. The system replaced manual sorting by detecting body visibility, posture, arm positions, camera angles, and props. Deployed on Amazon SageMaker with GPU-accelerated instances.
key_contributions: YOLO-based pose detection pipeline
Transformer-based image classification for contextual understanding
Amazon SageMaker deployment with GPU instances (ml.g4dn.xlarge)
PRFAQ-style documentation of results and learnings
3-minute video presentation of solution
projects.learnings: Edge cases in sports imagery (lighting, angles, partial occlusion) demand robust augmentation strategies more than more complex architectures.

key_contributions: PDF-to-CSV automated extraction pipeline
RAG architecture design and LLM integration
Reduction in manual data processing time

projects.title: Cranfield: Deep Learning for Computer Vision
projects.short_description: CIFAR-10 image classification with CNN/FCN/ResNet50V2 transfer learning, plus YOLOv8 vs Faster R-CNN UAV detection comparison.
projects.long_description: Developed and benchmarked multiple architectures for image classification (FCN, CNN, ResNet50V2 with progressive unfreezing) on CIFAR-10. Built and evaluated two UAV detection pipelines — YOLOv8n for speed and mAP, Faster R-CNN for detailed feature extraction — with comprehensive trade-off analysis.
key_contributions: FCN vs CNN comparison on CIFAR-10
Transfer learning with ResNet50V2 (progressive layer unfreezing)
YOLOv8n and Faster R-CNN UAV detection pipelines
mAP, IoU, loss curve evaluation

projects.title: Cranfield: Deep RL for Autonomous Driving
projects.short_description: DQN and PPO agents trained on OpenAI Gymnasium's CarRacing environment with advanced feature engineering.
projects.long_description: Modelled autonomous driving as a Markov Decision Process. Implemented DQN with grayscale conversion, 4-frame stacking, speed/track position features, and systematic hyperparameter tuning. Compared against PPO via ablation studies. Logged via TensorBoard, accelerated with Metal GPU on MacBook.
key_contributions: MDP formulation for CarRacing environment
DQN with frame stacking and auxiliary sensor features
PPO comparison and ablation studies
TensorBoard metric logging
Metal GPU acceleration on MacBook

design_guidance.tone: Confident, curious, hands-on. Not academic. Speaks in projects and outcomes.
suggested_sections: Hero — name, tagline, brief positioning statement
What I Build — skill clusters as visual cards (not a boring list)
Featured Projects — shipped work with outcomes and tech tags
In the Lab — ideas and in-progress projects, clearly labelled
About / Human side — interests, languages, fun facts
design_guidance.visual_direction: Clean and minimal with creative edge. Dark mode preferred. Skill clusters as interactive nodes. Projects should show status badges (Shipped / In Progress / Idea). Link disciplines to projects visually — e.g. clicking 'Computer Vision' highlights all CV projects.

prompt_for_site_generation: Use this JSON as the complete data source for a personal portfolio site for Toni Esan. The positioning is 'Multidisciplinary Creative Technologist' — not a standard engineer CV, but a visual, interconnected site that shows how disciplines connect. Key design requirements: (1) Featured projects section for shipped work with metrics and tech tags. (2) An 'In the Lab' section for ideas — clearly labelled but not hidden. (3) Skill clusters should be interactive and visually linked to projects. (4) Dark-mode-first, minimal but not cold. (5) The hero should feel confident and human, not corporate. All project IDs in skill_clusters.related_project_ids map to projects[].id. All skill_cluster IDs in projects[].skills_used map to skill_clusters[].id. Use these relationships to render the interactive skill-project graph.
